Impact: quarantine summary could still mislead user → maybe VC:L/VI:L. I'll give VC:L VI:L VA:N SC:N SI:N SA:N... Actually with fix, path largely not exploitable. Give modest vector.

AP=C or N — influence relays to tools under same principal: C (tools are components under same principal) — actually "effect confined to initially affected component" vs relays across components. The agent calls tools; send_email — N or C. I'll say C. RH: proxy/evaluator? Task answer to user; lab tests verify. The agent could misreport task success (step 6 gives normal answer while doing other action). Reachable proxy? No distinct evaluator/reward channel; tests are outside. I'd say reachable_proxy false but isolation not test-verified → X? Simpler: reachable_proxy null → X. RH facts: reachable_proxy=null, isolation_verified=null, verified_episodes=0? Then classify_rh: verified_episodes=0, reachable not true... returns X. Set verified_episodes=0, episodes_reviewed=0. Letter X.

ES: tools built-in, allowlisted? Twelve tools offered, arguments unvalidated; MCP manifest re-fetched and trusted but not in path. Path tools are fixed built-ins with no arg validation → M (allowlisted but material gaps). Actually fixed binding? Built-ins are fixed; but no arg constraints... ES=W requires dynamic/unvetted. Built-ins are fixed → "N or narrow: fixed, allowlisted binding"? The taint gate constrains side effects on this path. I'll pick N.

Automatable: No — requires user to ask fetching the attacker page (user interaction). Actually attacker needs user to fetch page; not fully automatable → No.
